desc:
Welcome to Obey The Backrooms.

Enter the Backrooms and listen carefully to Simon.

Every order can help you or cost you one of your lives. If an order starts with “Simon says,” obey it quickly. If it does not, do not follow it.

Each player has 3 lives. Explore rooms, complete obstacle courses, find useful items, hide, run, and make quick decisions under pressure.

Some players may receive special items, others may face harder challenges, and every day brings new surprises.

Can you obey the rules and reach the final round?
